title: One record for every roofing lead, from first click to paid job
summary: We made JobNimbus the single source of truth for a US roofing company and connected GoHighLevel, SalesRabbit and an operations app to it, with instant follow-up and AI booking agents on every lead page.
problem: Appointments, bookings and follow-up texts lived in separate apps. Leads from canvassing, a retail partner, paid campaigns, phone, TV and the website were entered by hand, the same customer often existed twice, and month-end numbers were pieced together from spreadsheets. Nobody could say which channel actually produced booked inspections.
overview: The platform follows a roofing lead from the moment it comes in to the moment the job is paid, and keeps one record of it the whole way. JobNimbus holds the truth; GoHighLevel handles every text, call and booking; SalesRabbit handles canvassing; and the operations app shows the numbers.

built.title: One source of truth
built.detail: Every lead, from canvassing, the retail partner, paid campaigns, phone and TV or the website, lands as a job in JobNimbus. GoHighLevel and the operations app read from it within moments.

built.title: A connector that never guesses
built.detail: It never creates the same customer twice, retries when a system is briefly down, and sends anything missing or contradictory to a review list. A nightly check reports anything that drifts out of step.

built.title: One sync for six boards
built.detail: A single JobNimbus to GoHighLevel workflow with one shared stage map covers roof restoration, replacement, canvassing, retail partner, attic fans and gutters.

built.title: Two-way CRM sync
built.detail: Cards moved in GoHighLevel update JobNimbus too, with a safeguard that stops the two systems bouncing the same change back and forth.

built.title: Canvasser credit without extra seats
built.detail: Canvassers pick their name in SalesRabbit when they book, and it arrives in JobNimbus already filled in, so commission goes to the right person.

built.title: Weekly retail partner import
built.detail: An upload screen that checks every row of the weekly spreadsheet, explains each problem, previews before saving and spots repeats by phone, address and date.

built.title: Instant lead follow-up
built.detail: The first text goes out the moment a lead arrives, at any hour, and an AI call follows within a minute. A ten-day chase steps down to weekly and stops when the customer books, replies or says no.

built.title: AI booking agents
built.detail: A voice agent and a text assistant for each lead page. They confirm the homeowner, offer two times, collect what the technician needs, and never quote a price or claim a booking that isn't in the calendar.

built.title: Real calendar booking
built.detail: Slots are held the moment they're offered, written to the inspections calendar and confirmed by text, with instant office alerts when a booking is made, moved or cancelled.

built.title: Three lead pages
built.detail: Attic Health, Gutter Solutions and the Roofing Portal, each with its own form and its own board in JobNimbus and GoHighLevel.

built.title: The operations app
built.detail: Roof sizes, sale values, who set and closed each job, a commission preview and a landing pages dashboard built around one number: booking rate.

built.title: Sales dashboard
built.detail: Speed to lead, outreach mix, appointments, pipeline by stage and performance by service line, in one view.

built.title: Data recovered from old jobs
built.detail: A look back through old jobs found sale values on 167 jobs and roof sizes on 104 that no report had ever read.
